mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with reduced discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is negative: lower FEDFUNDS predicts higher returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in the subset of observations where FEDFUNDS <= 1.5%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase above 245.5 signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank tightening expectations that lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in the subset of observations where CPIAUCSL > 245.5, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market strength is high (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%), it signals robust economic activity that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in the subset of observations where PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC between the joint condition and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 1200), a decline in housing starts (HOUST) relative to the prior month predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in the subset of observations where HOUST > 1200 and HOUST declines from the prior month, or the Rank IC between the joint condition and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is positive: higher INDPRO predicts higher returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05) in the subset of observations where INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly RSAFS decline below 450000 signals weakening residential demand, which triggers a negative market reaction and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in the subset of observations where RSAFS < 450000, or the Rank IC between RSAFS and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1200 and residential sales (RSAFS) fall below 450000, it signals a demand slowdown in the housing sector that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in the subset of observations where HOUST > 1200 AND RSAFS < 450000, or the Rank IC between the joint condition and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth > 0.5% in the last quarter), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to the prior month predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 0.5% in the last quarter
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05) in the subset of observations where GDPC1 growth > 0.5% in the last quarter and INDPRO declines from the prior month, or the Rank IC between the joint condition and 60-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
